paper_metadata.title: Hybrid Quantum-Classical Algorithm For Robust Optimization via Stochastic-Gradient Online Learning

experiments.description: Theoretical hybrid quantum-classical robust optimization meta-algorithm for generic convex feasibility problems with stochastic subgradient updates and oracle access; no numerical hardware experiment is reported.

algorithm.variant: Hybrid quantum-classical online sampling-based dual subgradient robust optimization algorithm
algorithm.convergence_criteria: Run for T iterations; returns INFEASIBLE if the optimization oracle declares infeasibility, otherwise outputs the averaged iterate

hyperparameters.D: diameter bound of uncertainty set U
hyperparameters.G1: sum of ℓ1 subgradient bounds across constraints
hyperparameters.G∞: maximum ℓ1 subgradient bound across constraints
hyperparameters.s: number of quantum samples per iteration

algorithm.parameter_initialization: Initialize (u1^(0), ..., um^(0)) arbitrarily in noise memory and x^(0) arbitrarily in D

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Quantum access to the noise memory and quantum subgradient oracle over indices (i,j) for constraint i and noise dimension j; stochastic subgradients are obtained by ℓ1-sampling from the md-dimensional gradient vector
problem_formulation.objective_function: Robust feasibility form of min f0(x) subject to fi(x, ui) ≤ 0 for all ui ∈ U, i ∈ [m]
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Online projected stochastic subgradient updates on noise vectors; feasibility checked by optimization oracle Oϵ; projection onto U via OP

problem_instance.description: Generic robust convex optimization instance; no concrete numerical benchmark is evaluated
problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: Theoretical analysis only; no empirical runs reported

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Binary search over objective value to reduce optimization to feasibility; stochastic subgradient oracle built from quantum state preparation, ℓ1-norm estimation, and multi-sampling
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Average iterates to obtain final solution; interpret oracle output as feasible or infeasible

results.value: sqrt(G1 G∞ G2) * sqrt(m d) D^2 / ε^2
min{G1 G∞, G2^2 m} D^2 / ε^2

speedup_claims.baseline_method: Ben-Tal et al. (2015) classical oracle-based robust optimization meta-algorithm
speedup_claims.conditions: when G1 G∞ is comparable to G2^2; more generally, advantage depends on sparsity/localization of subgradients
speedup_claims.caveats: No numerical experiment; advantage is asymptotic and depends on bounds G1, G∞, and sampling parameter s.

complexity_analysis.quantum_complexity: eO(((sqrt(smd) + s) T∇ + min{m, s} TP + Tϵ) / ϵ^2 * max{F, D^2 (G2^2 + (G1G∞ - G2^2)/s)})
complexity_analysis.classical_complexity: O((D^2 G2^2 / ϵ^2) * (md T∇ + m TP + Tϵ))

experiments.description: Application of the hybrid robust optimization algorithm to robust linear programming with ellipsoidal uncertainty, including the global maximum return portfolio formulation.

algorithm.variant: Hybrid quantum-classical robust optimization for robust LPs with ellipsoidal uncertainty
algorithm.convergence_criteria: Same as the generic robust optimization meta-algorithm; no separate empirical stopping rule reported
algorithm.parameter_initialization: Not specified beyond generic algorithm initialization

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Noise vectors ui are updated in memory; robust LP constraints are linear in ui with ellipsoidal perturbation matrices Pi
problem_formulation.objective_function: Feasibility form of (ai + Pi ui)^T x - bi ≤ 0 for all ui in unit ball U
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Projection onto Euclidean ball U; optimization oracle Oϵ for the underlying LP feasibility problem

problem_instance.description: Robust LP with ellipsoidal noise; includes a finance example, the Global Maximum Return Portfolio (GMRP)

dataset_specification.description: Assets with uncertain expected returns ri = eri + κi Si^{1/2} ui; no ticker list, date range, or dataset split reported

problem_instance.data_preprocessing_details: Returns are estimated and modeled with ellipsoidal uncertainty via covariance/shape matrices Si; no further preprocessing details reported
problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: Theoretical corollary only; no numerical benchmark or run protocol reported

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Formulate robust LP as feasibility problem; for GMRP, replace returns by ellipsoidally perturbed estimates eri + κi Si^{1/2} ui
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Interpret averaged iterate as portfolio/feasibility certificate

speedup_claims.baseline_method: Ben-Tal et al. (2015) classical robust LP meta-algorithm
speedup_claims.caveats: No empirical benchmark; speedup is in dimension d and depends on matrix norm ratios.

complexity_analysis.quantum_complexity: eO(((sqrt(G1G∞)/G2) * sqrt(md) T∇ + min{m, G1G∞/G2^2} TP + Tϵ) * G2^2 / ϵ^2)
complexity_analysis.classical_complexity: eO((md T∇ + m TP + Tϵ) * G2^2 / ϵ^2)

experiments.description: Application of the hybrid robust optimization algorithm to robust semidefinite programming with ellipsoidal uncertainty.

algorithm.variant: Hybrid quantum-classical robust optimization for robust SDPs with ellipsoidal uncertainty
algorithm.convergence_criteria: Same as the generic robust optimization meta-algorithm; no separate empirical stopping rule reported
algorithm.parameter_initialization: Not specified beyond generic algorithm initialization

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Noise vector u ∈ R^d perturbs SDP constraint matrices via Ai + Σ_j u_j P_j; quantum subgradient access is over entries (P_j • X)
problem_formulation.objective_function: Feasibility form of (Ai + Σ_j u_j P_j) • X - bi ≤ 0 for all u in unit ball U
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Projection onto Euclidean ball U; optimization oracle Oϵ for the underlying SDP feasibility problem

problem_instance.description: Robust SDP with ellipsoidal uncertainty; includes the Truss Topology Design (TTD) structural design example

dataset_specification.description: Uses nodal geometry v1,...,vm, load vector f, and ellipsoidal load matrix Q; no numerical instance size or dataset split reported

problem_instance.data_preprocessing_details: Robust load modeled as Qu with ||u||2 ≤ 1; matrices P_j constructed from columns Q_j
problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: Theoretical corollary only; no numerical benchmark or run protocol reported

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Formulate robust SDP as feasibility problem; for TTD, convert the design problem to a dual/primal SDP with ellipsoidal load uncertainty
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Interpret averaged iterate as SDP feasibility certificate

results.value: eO(((Σ/σ) m sqrt(d) T∇ + m TP + Tϵ) * σ^2 / ε^2)

speedup_claims.baseline_method: Ben-Tal et al. (2015) classical robust SDP meta-algorithm
speedup_claims.caveats: No numerical benchmark; advantage depends on Frobenius-norm concentration across perturbation matrices P_j.

complexity_analysis.quantum_complexity: eO(((Sigma/sigma) * m * sqrt(d) T∇ + m TP + Tϵ) * sigma^2 / ϵ^2)
complexity_analysis.classical_complexity: eO((md T∇ + m TP + Tϵ) * sigma^2 / ϵ^2)
